mentions.name: dotipa
mentions.description: A macOS app (dotipa) that analyzes iOS app size metrics and surfaces optimization opportunities. It lets users export build metadata as JSON for LLM-based analysis, and the author is adding Apple Intelligence support so a locally running, on-device assistant can act like an iOS build engineer and provide optimization guidance.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on adding Apple Intelligence to my macOS app built to analyze iOS app size metrics. I'm hoping to have a locally running assistant that can act like an iOS build engineer to provide optimization opportunities and more: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/dotipa/id6742254881.
